day_night.notes: Flat sea-horizon sunrise/sunset, ~5 minute resolution; does not correct for atmospheric refraction or local terrain.

tidal_character.notes: Astronomical spring/neap character derived from Sun-Moon elongation. Does not model meteorological storm surge or absolute water height.
tidal_character.lunitidal_interval_source: User-provided reference: Sligo Port high-water lag ~4h45m-5h00m behind lunar transit.
tidal_character.timing_notes: HW/LW times follow the Moon's local transits offset by a constant assumed port lag; see lunitidal_interval_source for where that lag came from. No harmonic constituents or absolute water height are modelled, and the lag is treated as constant rather than varying with spring/neap state.

calendar_note: Date is treated as proleptic Gregorian. Spain had adopted the Gregorian calendar by 1588 and Armada-side accounts (e.g. Cuellar) use it; contemporary English/Irish records of the same era may use the Julian ('Old Style') calendar, roughly 10 days earlier -- if a source is explicitly Old Style, convert before using this module, since it shifts the moon phase by ~10 days and can flip the spring/neap classification.
